title: Meta announces a deal to use "tens of millions" of Amazon's Graviton chips to help deliver its next generation of AI models, amid a shortage of Nvidia chips (Ina Fried/Axios)
summary: Ina Fried / Axios: Meta announces a deal to use “tens of millions” of Amazon's Graviton chips to help deliver its next generation of AI models, amid a shortage of Nvidia chips — Meta on Friday announced a deal to use Amazon-designed chips to help deliver its next generation of AI models.
contentText:
Ina Fried / Axios :

Meta inks deal to use more Amazon chips   —  Meta on Friday announced a deal to use Amazon-designed chips to help deliver its next generation of AI models. … - The new pact, which builds on an existing partnership between AWS and Meta, will make Meta one of the largest users of Graviton chips, the companies said.
